objective: Calibrate a one-sided abstention threshold for the single preselected v3.2 survivor zeta34 on a previously sealed independent profile, without reopening feature discovery.

feature.name: zeta34
feature.recommendation_rule: recommend E audit admissibility only if zeta34 <= tau; otherwise abstain to R-JF

data_firewall.N96_N256: discovery only; forbidden for v3.3 threshold selection

candidate_thresholds: all-abstain plus every distinct finite calibration zeta34 value; recommend iff zeta34 <= tau

selection.primary: among zero-unsafe candidates, choose maximum recommendation count subject to the family/coverage gates
selection.safety_margin: replace selected tau by the immediately preceding distinct finite zeta34 value; then re-evaluate every calibration gate; if no predecessor or any gate fails, all-abstain
selection.no_probability_claim: This deterministic calibration is not claimed to have finite-sample statistical coverage; the separately sealed N384 holdout is the empirical promotion authority.

runtime_contract.audit_full_e_endpoint: allowed only to label calibration events

holdout_rule: If and only if v3.3 yields a nontrivial frozen threshold, commit the threshold, raw N192 input hashes, selection scan, and source state before N384 is opened in a separate node. If v3.3 yields all-abstain, N384 remains sealed.
forbidden: N384 execution before a nontrivial v3.3 policy is committed
